title: China's Tallest Tower Twists 120° — the Twist Saved $58M in Steel | China Travel Expert
description:
China's tallest building twists 120° — and the twist is pure engineering.

The Shanghai Tower rises 632 meters over Lujiazui across 128 floors, making it China's tallest building and the world's third-tallest. Its whole body spirals 120 degrees from base to crown — and not just for looks: the twist cuts wind load by about 24%, which let engineers save roughly $58 million in structural steel in one of the world's most typhoon-exposed cities. It topped out in 2014.

🧭 Expert Tip: Buy the Shanghai Tower observation-deck ticket online before you go — the walk-up line down in Lujiazui can eat an hour on a weekend.
